data.name: Aile
data.gender_notes: Aile is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'hailē', meaning 'little, radiant, shining'. Aile was a common Greek name for girls, especially in ancient Sparta. The name Aile carries the meaning “Little, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Aile usually hope their child will grow to embody little, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of hope and light, shining in the darkness.
data.etymology: Aile belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little, Radiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aile total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Aile would have held great significance during the ancient Greek civilisation, where it was a common name for girls. In Sparta, one of the most famous city-states of ancient Greece, Aile was believed to bring luck and prosperity. Girl children named Aile were considered to be blessed and protected by the gods.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christianity, the name Aile evokes a sense of brightness and illumination, representative of the divine light of Christ. The spiritual significance of the name goes beyond just a pretty sounding name, but is a reminder of God's presence in our lives, illuminating our paths and guiding us towards the light of salvation.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Aile could be derived from the Hebrew name "Eilah," meaning "goddess of the heights." In Christianity, this name represents a deep connection with God, seeking guidance and strength from the divine heights. It symbolizes a life dedicated to spiritual growth and an unwavering faith in God's protection.
